summary: Full E2E testing of new 'Import Produk Massal' feature (backend + frontend). All 6 pytest cases pass and Playwright UI flow works end-to-end. Bulk import correctly strips prefixes (arrow ➥, dash -, 1., 2), *, •), dedupes case-insensitively, creates products with correct defaults (photo='', price=0, commission=10%, stock=available), shows success toast, updates 'Belum Lengkap' badge + count, and imported products appear on public storefront. Cleanup of test products completed.

Frontend defaults match backend defaults — parity confirmed.
BULK_PREFIX_REGEX supports stacked prefixes and all requested tokens (➥ → > - * • 1. 2)).
Dedup done both client-side (preview) and backend (case-insensitive) — good defense in depth.
